scientific_integrity: The proof is elementary and self-contained; references supply prior context only. A separately executable finite checker cross-checks the derived formulas. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only equal positive powers of two permutations of one finite alphabet are treated, and only their first distinguishing length. The independence polynomial need not determine an ordering uniquely. Finite checks do not replace proof; unindexed equivalent prior work remains possible.
title: First Simon-disagreement spectra of permutation powers and inversion graphs
